text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So, our Fleetfoot Festival training camp
has officially started, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Phew... Damn it. This isn't enough.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Brian! There you are.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Rudolf... What do you want? If it's about
archery training, we still
have some time
until it starts.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Well, if you can get ready with
lightning speed, then yes, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Then that's what I'll do. Leave me alone.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe that in between the
blood-boiling battles of the Kikuka Sho,
the autumn Tenno Sho, the Japan Cup,
and the Arima Kinen, I'm wasting away out
here in the sticks.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
How am I supposed to sharpen my fangs
like this?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Brian...

text_block_list.name: Dance Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Good work, everyone! Let's call it a day
here.

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Dance Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Curren, your moves have improved a lot.
Yukino, try and relax your
shoulders a bit.

text_block_list.name: Dance Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Especially when it's your turn to take
center stage. That part is the
highlight of
the performance, so enjoy it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
O-okay!
I'll practice 'til I'm jump'n and jiv'n
the whole time!

text_block_list.name: Dance Teacher
text_block_list.text:
And City... Hmm... Your dancing is
beautiful, but...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: But?

text_block_list.name: Dance Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... No, never mind. You're doing great
just as you are!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Really? Well, as long as it's pretty,
that's
all that matters.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Okay. So you received the
night-time leave documents. Thank
you for
the swift response, Air Groove. Bye now.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: President! Oh... Sorry!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Not to worry, I've just finished on the
phone. Can I help you with
something?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Well...
I'm not sure if it's anything worth
bringing up yet, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I see.
So the team isn't meshing so well on
your side either. Thank you
for notifying
me, Curren.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I've actually been thinking of some
measures for that very issue, and
the
preparations have just been put in place.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Wow, really?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I will coax Brian into coming with us
on my end, so I'd like to task
you with
bringing Gold City and Yukino Bijin along
on yours.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wow, they even have fireworks! I'd heard
this autumn festival was big,
and it's true!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
The person from the inn said this was a
pretty lively festival for the
area. Ahh, the
food stalls smell so good.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
B-but... should we really be enjoy'n a
festival right now? We didn't
come here to
dilly-dally...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
We're starting with the basics, Yukino
Bijin. Our task is to make sure people
enjoy the festival,
so it is vital that we see
one with our own eyes. Now...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Brian, which stall would you like to try
first? I like local items that
have a regional
flavor. Perhaps I'll buy some for the
student council as thanks for filling in
during my absence.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You did enough work to tide them over for
your absence and more,
though. Whatever.
I'm hungry.
Let's just find something to eat.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
The lanterns on that shop are so cute and
colorful! The lighting is nice
and soft, and
if I stand right about here and look over
my shoulder... Mm-hm! The perfect shot! ♪

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, true. I'll take it for you later,
Curren.
What about you, Yukino?
Don't be shy if
there's anywhere you wanna check out too.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Umm, in that case, the yo-yo fishing? Ah,
but that's too childish, isn't
it? Haha!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Why not? Sounds good to me. The designs
are usually pretty cute
too. Besides... that's
such a Yukino thing to do!
I'll snap a pic of that too.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Gee, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Local Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
E-excuse me! You're Curren, right? Sorry
to approach you out of the
blue! It's just
I... I follow you on Umastagram!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, thank you! I'm glad you came to speak
to me! ♪

text_block_list.name: Local Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
You're training for the ceremonial
dance at the Fleetfoot Festival
right now, aren't you? Ooh,
I just can't wait! I'll definitely
come and see it!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, I'll see you there! Oh, and please
use the tags "#Curren" and 
"#CeremonialDance" when you post about
it, okay? ♪ I'll be searching for people's
comments! ☆

text_block_list.name: Local Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay! We're gonna make sure you're
trending! Thank you for
talking to me in
your private time!
I'll leave you to it now!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Your post about the ceremonial dance
went pretty viral, huh.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
This whole dance thing is a bit different
from my usual vibe, so I think everyone's
just surprised.
I'm glad the reactions have been mostly
positive on the whole though! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
And with that,
I think I've done a good job
of playing my role.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: What do you mean, your role?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Like, my part? I think I was chosen as a
mascot this time around. My image doesn't
exactly shout "history" or "tradition" or
anything,
y'know?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So I thought I'd do what I do best and
make sure this festival goes viral. I'm
serious about the dance, though. I wanna
surprise people
with that.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Or at least,
that's what I thought would be
cutest! ♪

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Curren... Oh. Wow, you're amazing.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Seriously... amazing.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, what a wonderful aroma! The scent
of sizzling sauce is truly
exceptional. Brian,
shall we go to the yakisoba stand next? I
bet that's the "sauce" of that scent...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I don't want any. Not enough meat. That
won't fire up my body at all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hm, if you say sauce. Let's go down that
path over there then! They had skewered
meat and vegetables on the grill. I'm sure
we'll find
something to your taste.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Tch... What is this? Trying to act like my
older sister? As if you're
doing me a favor?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Not at all.
I don't intend to challenge Biwa
Hayahide in that regard.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I just... want you to enjoy yourself.
However you see fit.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Just have fun, Brian. That goes for this
festival, the Fleetfoot Festival,
and the
archery show with me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That's all I wish for you.
